saw_lines: Gaming PC buyers compare builds by spec sheet, then need proof the box will run smoothly before they pay.
So the sale is decided in the ad, where a buyer looks for a price and a proof number before clicking.
Your 30 live ads never mention price, so buyers comparing gaming PCs have no number to weigh. Put the MG-1 price on three creatives next to the cost of its parts.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: 0 of your 30 live ads mention price, so buyers comparing gaming PCs have no number to weigh. Next, put the MG-1 price on three new creatives and set it beside the cost of the same parts bought separately.

None of your 30 live ads carries a proof number, so a buyer scrolling past has nothing to trust in the first seconds. Next, collect one figure such as your review count or orders shipped, then lead three ads with it.

3 of your 21 ads are creator posts with a code, #ad and an @mention, run from your brand page, which lowers trust with new buyers. Next, whitelist those three posts from the creator account and cut three variations of each.
5 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product on screen, so a buyer who clicks an MG-1 ad has to search for it. Next, point those five ads to the MG-1 page they show.

ads_1: MG-1 creatives led by price, with the new proof figure as the closing line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube
